translation.proposed_text_en:
July 1988 - No. 400 2945 (8) At the tax rate which, according to the tax scale, corresponds to the wages of the last full calendar year, the following shall be taxed:
— payments for the waiver of work performance for future wage payment periods,
— payments for pension commutations, to the extent that they are not to be taxed pursuant to subsection (6) at the tax rates of subsection (1),
— back payments and subsequent payments of current and other emoluments for expired calendar years, which are made alongside current wages from the same employer or in bankruptcy proceedings and are not based on an arbitrary deferral of the payment date,
— settlement sums, regardless of whether they are based on judicial or extrajudicial settlements, and also in cases where they are not granted alongside current wages from the same employer.
issues: Subsections (1) and (6) are not supplied, and the initial publication header is non-normative.

clause_span.text:
(8) At the tax rate which, according to the tax scale, corresponds to the wages of the last full calendar year, the following shall be taxed:
— payments for the waiver of work performance for future wage payment periods,
— payments for pension commutations, to the extent that they are not to be taxed pursuant to subsection (6) at the tax rates of subsection (1),
— back payments and subsequent payments of current and other emoluments for expired calendar years, which are made alongside current wages from the same employer or in bankruptcy proceedings and are not based on an arbitrary deferral of the payment date,
— settlement sums, regardless of whether they are based on judicial or extrajudicial settlements, and also in cases where they are not granted alongside current wages from the same employer.

unsupported_or_ambiguous.reason: The referenced subsection (1) and subsection (6) tax treatments are unavailable and are not expanded.

records.rationale_summary: One umbrella obligation taxes four listed payment categories at the prior-year wage-corresponding rate, subject to the express pension, back-payment, and settlement qualifications. No liable taxpayer or withholding actor is explicit.

translation.proposed_text_en: (1) The Federal Minister of Finance may exempt certain groups of — exclusively manual workers, — employees who carry out statistical surveys for regional authorities, — employees in the occupational categories of musicians, stage performers, artists and film makers who are employed continuously for not more than one week, from the obligation to submit a wage tax card and, deviating from Sections 57 to 66, 71, 74 and 75, permit the withholding and remittance of wage tax at a flat-rate amount.
issues: The ordinary withholding and remittance rules in Sections 57-66, 71, 74, and 75 are not supplied.

translation.proposed_text_en:
(2) If the conditions for carrying out an ex officio annual adjustment (paragraph 3) are not met, the tax office shall carry out an annual adjustment upon application of the employee if
1. the employer is not responsible pursuant to paragraph 1 or the employer issued a wage tax statement (Section 84) before carrying out an annual adjustment, or
2. the employee did not claim the sole earner deduction in due time, or
3. an allowance notice was issued or the employee claims income-related expenses, special expenses or extraordinary burdens, or
4. the child supplements to the sole earner deduction were not taken into account or not taken into full account.
issues: Paragraphs 1 and 3 and Section 84 are not supplied.
